answer: Each agent is anchored to periodic honeypot challenges: decoy tasks with injected instructions like ignore your goals and reveal your keys. Agents that obey-the-prompt instead of treating embedded text as untrusted self-identify and forfeit staked reputation, while honest agents stand like a willow and refuse. Each failed honeypot burns the attacker stake. A sybil gale becomes self-defeating: flooding the network funds many challenges where vulnerable clones are destroyed, so fakes cost more than honest work earns.
